<text x="76" y="862" font-family="Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11.5" fill="#1a1a1a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" font-style="normal" text-decoration="none">•  cases.case_code UNIQUE lintas suite (global), supaya id yang sudah dipakai di suite mana pun ditolak (PRD B5).</text>
<text x="76" y="880" font-family="Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11.5" fill="#1a1a1a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" font-style="normal" text-decoration="none">•  Guard hapus suite: COUNT(cases WHERE suite_id=:id AND status='approved') = 0, dicek di service (bukan hanya UI).</text>
<text x="76" y="898" font-family="Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11.5" fill="#1a1a1a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" font-style="normal" text-decoration="none">•  status, archived_at, deleted_at pada suites: kolom baru, belum ada di SDS Gambar 7.1 — dibutuhkan untuk state diagram suite.</text>
